independentUnit: groupID within language and condition; repeats remain clustered
coldDefinition: fresh benchmark subprocess; filesystem and GPU-driver caches are uncontrolled
warmDefinition: same subprocess and model instances after cold attempt and recorded warmups
latencyEndpoint: production LocalTranslationStream model publication; excludes capture hardware and paint
retryPolicy: none; every planned attempt, failure, deadline and skipped attempt is retained
qualityClaim: engineering regression only; no model promotion or general accuracy claim
